title: BDD slice A: three café scenarios, with a real-agent measurement
item: Build the BDD tests for café scenarios SC-08, SC-12 and SC-10 end to end, prove them on a scripted agent, and measure with a throwaway real LLM agent whether their verdicts are right
motivation: First slice of task 1. It tests the riskiest assumption before anything larger is built: that tests proven on a scripted agent give right verdicts on a real LLM agent. It also shows the test format to the owner on 3 scenarios.
notes: The full description is the section 'Slice A' of tasks/plans/001.md; read the whole plan first, terms included. Work goes in .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/examples/cafe/ (no SKILL.md yet; the skill is written in a later slice). The spec is .claude/skills/agent-spec/examples/cafe/spec/; read it, and read .claude/skills/agent-spec/scripts/check.py for how a scenario replays through model.py; edit neither. Build in the plan's order, data file first. Save every probe-agent transcript in one folder and the checkers' verdicts in another, so the transcripts can be labelled without seeing the verdicts. Part 2 calls the Claude API. The owner is logged in with the ant CLI (`ant auth login`) and has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set; do not park for a missing key. Run `ant auth status` first. Use, in this order: the Python SDK if it picks up the ant login by itself; else the SDK with ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN set from `ant auth print-credentials --access-token`, fetched again when a call is refused as expired; else `ant messages create` as a subprocess. Never write a token or key to a file or a log. Only if `ant auth status` shows no login and no key is set: finish part 1, write that under needs_you and park. Spend at most 5 USD on part 2 and report what was spent. The probe agent's model is a draft choice: a mid-size current Claude model, named in the report. Do not open the branch add-agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd.
done_means: For SC-08, SC-12 and SC-10: (1) 3 of 3 pass with the reference agent, with 0 LLM calls; (2) each of the 2 broken variants (R-03, R-11) fails the Then sentence of its own rule; (3) every value a step, the fake or a replayed history uses comes from the data file, every entry there is labelled 'from the spec' with its claim or rule, or 'free choice', and the feature files equal the script's output; (4) on the 27 one-action probe runs the rule checkers agree with the labels Claude in chat gives the transcripts on at least 9 of every 10 rule verdicts, every disagreement listed; (5) for each of the 2 bad prompts at least 1 run shows the bad behaviour and is failed on its rule. Reported with the result: runs that reach a verdict out of 27 and out of 9 whole conversations, pass rate per rule, money spent.
draft_note: Drafted by Claude in chat on 2026-11-16 from tasks/plans/001.md. Lines 1 to 3 of done_means are for script and reviewer; lines 4 and 5 need the owner to bring the transcripts to chat, which is why verified_by includes you. Set to Ready on 2026-11-17 by Claude in chat on the owner's instruction ("set Task 49 to ready").

needs_you.question: Part 1 is built, reviewed (second review PASS) and its 5 check commands exit 0 on branch task/049. Part 2 (done_means lines 4 and 5) did not run: your ant login authenticates, but the API refuses every call with 'Your credit balance is too low'. $0 spent. Also, verified_by includes you: read the 3 feature files in .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/examples/cafe/features/ and say whether this is the test format you want. Note: your chat session's commit 07be3ca (task notes and plan now use the ant login) is only on task/049; this park did not carry it to the working branch.
needs_you.recommendation: Add about $5 of API credit, run `ant auth login` again if the token has expired (it expires 15:36 on 2026-11-17), then from the cafe folder run `uv run python probe/run_part2.py` (stops itself at $4.50). Bring runs/part2/transcripts/ to chat for labelling before opening runs/part2/verdicts/. Then set 049 back to Ready so the manager merges task/049 with the results.
needs_you.if_vetoed: If you do not add credit, lines 4 and 5 cannot be shown and slices B to E (tasks 50 to 53) stay blocked on the riskiest assumption; the alternative is to merge part 1 alone after changing done_means to drop lines 4 and 5 into a new task.

decided_for_you.chosen: Probe model claude-sonnet-5-5, priced at grading.json model_rates.sonnet ($2 in / $10 out per million)
decided_for_you.rejected: Another model, or prices from elsewhere
decided_for_you.would_change: If you name another model or the real sonnet-5-5 price differs

decided_for_you.chosen: Each tested moment runs in one home scenario and is judged on that scenario's cited rules
decided_for_you.rejected: Judging every scenario's rules at every moment, which adds trivially held verdicts and inflates line 4's agreement
decided_for_you.would_change: If you want the union of rules; change moments.*.scenario and CITED

decided_for_you.chosen: Histories stored literally in data.json, kept equal to the reference run by tests
decided_for_you.rejected: Storing histories as references into other entries
decided_for_you.would_change: If the file grows too large to read in slice B

decided_for_you.chosen: The second sentence of R-01 (tell the visitor after 'taken' or no answer) is not checked
